stories.title: Vicente Vallés, sobre si Pedro Sánchez convocará elecciones tras la derrota de los decretos de vivienda: «Aunque no pueda gobernar»

en.title: Vicente Vallés, on whether Pedro Sánchez will call elections after the defeat of housing decrees: "Even if he cannot govern"
en.summary: Spain's Congress rejected two housing decrees on October 2, with PP, Vox, Junts, and UPN voting against them. The measures included eviction suspensions and rental price limits.

stories.title: Al menos 11 heridos por el derrumbe de un bar en San Vicente de la Sonsierra (La Rioja)

en.title: At least 11 injured in bar collapse in San Vicente de la Sonsierra (La Rioja)
en.summary: A bar collapsed early morning in La Rioja, injuring at least 12 people, with about 50 patrons inside at the time. Eight injured required hospital transport, with the floor collapsing first followed by the ceiling.

stories.title: El derrumbe del techo de un bar en un pueblo de La Rioja causa 12 heridos

en.title: The collapse of a bar roof in a La Rioja town causes 12 injured
en.summary: A bar ceiling collapsed in La Rioja, trapping approximately 50 people inside and resulting in 12 injuries.

stories.title: Al menos 11 heridos tras colapsar un bar en San Vicente de la Sonsierra

en.title: At least 11 injured after a bar collapses in San Vicente de la Sonsierra
en.summary: A bar in San Vicente de la Sonsierra collapsed, injuring at least 11 people, with eight requiring hospital treatment.

stories.title: Emiratos confirma que el copiloto de FlyDubai atacó con un hacha al piloto en la cabina

en.title: Emirates confirms FlyDubai copilot attacked pilot with axe in cockpit
en.summary: Emirati authorities stated that a FlyDubai copilot attacked the pilot with an axe in the cockpit. The General Prosecutor's office characterized the incident as a terrorist attack.

stories.title: Doce personas heridas tras el derrumbe de un bar en San Vicente de la Sonsierra (La Rioja)

en.title: Twelve people injured after bar collapse in San Vicente de la Sonsierra, La Rioja
en.summary: A bar structure collapsed early in the morning in a Spanish town, injuring twelve people and trapping over twenty individuals in the rubble.

stories.title: Pablo Bustinduy: “Las elecciones, cuando sean, van a ser un referéndum sobre la vivienda”

en.title: Pablo Bustinduy: "Elections, whenever they are, will be a referendum on housing"
en.summary: Spain's Minister of Social Rights stated that upcoming elections will serve as a referendum on housing issues and criticized Junts' political position as self-destructive.

stories.title: El copiloto de Flydubai que estuvo a punto de estrellar el avión tenía prohibido volar en Omán por sospechas de extremismo y atacó a su compañero con un hacha

en.title: FlyDubai copilot banned from flying in Oman over extremism suspicions attacked colleague with axe
en.summary: A FlyDubai copilot prohibited from flying in Oman due to extremism concerns attacked his pilot with an axe during flight. Questions arose about the thoroughness of background checks when he was hired by the Emirates-based airline.

stories.title: Muere una mujer centenaria tras inundarse su casa por la riada de Madrigueras (Albacete)

en.title: Centenarian woman dies after her home floods during Madrigueras flooding in Albacete
en.summary: A 102-year-old woman died in her home during severe flooding in Madrigueras, Albacete, after intense rainfall exceeding 140 liters per square meter. Emergency services rescued around 90 people from flooded homes, basements, and garages.

stories.title: Muere una mujer de 102 años y rescatan a 90 en la riada de Madrigueras (Albacete)

en.title: A 102-year-old woman dies and 90 people are rescued in flooding in Madrigueras (Albacete)
en.summary: Heavy rainfall of 142 liters per square meter struck the Albacete municipality, triggering emergency response protocols and resulting in one death and multiple rescues.

stories.title: La riada por las lluvias intensas en Albacete se cobra la vida de una mujer

en.title: Flooding from intense rainfall in Albacete claims the life of a woman
en.summary: Intense rainfall caused severe flooding in Albacete, resulting in one death. Rescue services evacuated approximately 90 people from the affected areas in Madrigueras.

stories.title: Feijóo exige elecciones a Sánchez tras el rechazo a los decretos de vivienda: “La escapada debe terminar aquí”

en.title: Feijóo demands elections from Sánchez after rejection of housing decrees: "The escape must end here"
en.summary: The PP leader calls on the government president to hold elections following the parliamentary defeat on housing measures.

stories.title: Five Guys acelera sus aperturas en España con ocho locales al año

en.title: Five Guys accelerates its openings in Spain with eight locations per year
en.summary: Five Guys plans to reach 50 stores in Spain by 2027, with double-digit growth expected this year.

stories.title: ¿Quién manda en los escúteres de rueda alta?

en.title: Who dominates the large-wheel scooter market?
en.summary: Large-wheel scooters became prevalent in Spain starting with Honda Scoopy's 16-inch wheel design, offering better stability on urban terrain before the market shifted toward smaller 13 and 14-inch wheel models.

stories.title: La Caixa blinda su poder en el consejo de Naturgy

en.title: La Caixa strengthens its power on Naturgy's board
en.summary: Naturgy announced key changes to its board voting system through official regulatory filings.

stories.title: Iberdrola y Telefónica, contra el decreto de centros de datos

en.title: Iberdrola and Telefónica oppose the data centers decree
en.summary: Iberdrola's CEO in Spain argued against demonizing data centers, opposing a government decree affecting their development.

stories.title: Repsol y Santander baten beneficios y lideran el récord de cotizadas

en.title: Repsol and Santander beat profits and lead record for listed companies
en.summary: Spanish listed companies achieved record profits, with banking, energy, and concessions sectors driving a 15.5% increase in overall earnings and a 6.6% rise in revenue.
